channel.title: The Barons of AI
channel.description: Founder stories from the intelligence age. The Barons of AI is a biography podcast about the founders building artificial intelligence — the entrepreneurs, engineers, and iconoclasts turning AI research into industries. Each episode goes deep on one builder: where they came from, the decisions that mattered, and the lessons worth stealing. From DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng to Octopus Energy founder Greg Jackson — startup stories and founder biographies for anyone who wants to understand how the future gets built.
channel.itunes:author: The Barons of AI

item.title: Henk Vietor and Vitol
item.description:
A Founders-style biography of Henk Vietor, co-founder of Vitol — the world's largest independent oil trader. From a 10,000-guilder loan and a six-month ultimatum in 1966 Rotterdam to $343B in annual turnover: the founder who vanished in 1976, the 1990 employee buyout, the Come by Chance refinery gamble, the Enron offer refused, the 2011 Benghazi fuel run — and five lessons on being long volatility.
Chapters: (00:00) The Four-Minute Yes (01:55) The Ghost (04:55) Unhedged (07:26) The Machine (13:13) The Ledger (16:53) Vee-Tol

item.title: Zhang Yiming and ByteDance
item.description:
A Founders-style biography of Zhang Yiming, founder of ByteDance — the company behind TikTok, Douyin, and Toutiao. From a four-bedroom Beijing apartment to the world's most valuable startup: the no-editors bet on recommendation algorithms, the Musical.ly acquisition, the 2018 apology letter, the TikTok forced-sale saga, the daydream memo — and four lessons on trusting revealed behavior over expert opinion.
Chapters: (00:00) The Apology (01:23) Escape Velocity (04:31) Napkins (07:40) Push, Don't Search (10:28) The Other Four-Fifths (14:03) Daydreams

item.title: Liang Wenfeng and DeepSeek
item.description:
A Founders-style biography of Liang Wenfeng, founder of DeepSeek — the Chinese AI lab whose R1 reasoning model shocked Silicon Valley and wiped $600B off Nvidia in a day. From quant trader at High-Flyer to stockpiling 10,000 GPUs before the chip ban: the DeepSeek story, the V3 training-cost breakthrough, open-source AI strategy, and four lessons on originality over imitation.
Chapters: (00:00) Sputnik Moment (01:22) A Fifth-Tier Childhood (03:48) The Quant Years (07:06) Buying the Piano (14:17) What Is Worth Stealing (17:42) Epitaph

item.title: Greg Jackson and Octopus Energy
item.description:
A Founders-style biography of Greg Jackson, who founded Octopus Energy in 2016 and built it into Britain's largest energy supplier — with the Kraken energy software platform spun out at an $8.65B valuation. From a childhood with the power cut off to overtaking British Gas: the founding story, the Bulb acquisition, and seven lessons on building a tech-driven energy company.
Chapters: (00:00) The Most Hated Industry (00:54) The Milk Round (02:58) Two Sparks (04:21) Building Kraken (05:55) Licensing to the Enemy (07:19) Nine Billion in Four Years (08:06) The Bulb Heist (09:48) Number One (10:19) Fairness as Strategy (12:07) Seven Lessons (14:30) The Customer
